annotations.title: Check an origin for one standard

description: Check one public origin over HTTPS for a single standard or manifest (rate-limited to 120/min). Returns { origin, id, found, outcome, status, url, reason, article } without grading the full site. Use has for a fast single-file check; use probe to evaluate all 37 protocol probe rules at once, or validate_manifest for A+–F conformance grading.

id.description: probed standard id or filename (e.g. ard, llms-txt, mcp-server-cards, robots.txt)

origin.description: public hostname to check (e.g. agenticweb.wiki, cloudflare.com)

name: has
